lines.en: Seek decayed flesh, fill your belly.
I root through the dirt for buried meat.

lines.zh: 肚子一直在叫，停不下来。
尸体在哪儿，我就往哪儿走。
lines.en: Where the corpses are, I go.
My snout is full of the smell of rust.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛全是黑的，看着你。
lines.en: My eyes are all black, and they're on you.

lines.zh: 你带来的东西我吃得下。
lines.en: Whatever you brought, I can eat.
Eat you, cannibal! — Cannibal Pig, look player
Decay, my life — Cannibal Pig, look player
You stand still like good meat.
I am looking at the meat on your neck.
Don't play dead—I smell the living.
A knock on the pig snout. Oink.
That one left my neck crooked.
I am only a pig. Stop hitting me.
A corner of my tusk chipped off.

lines.zh: 哼！谁打的？我记住这味道了。
lines.en: Oink! Who hit me? I remember that smell.

lines.zh: 瘦弱的肉在眼前晃动，我忍不住流口水。
lines.en: Lean flesh sways before me, saliva drips.

lines.zh: 我的胃在咕咕叫，渴望着。
lines.en: My stomach growls, yearning for more.

lines.zh: 这尸体散发出腐烂的香味。
lines.en: Decaying flesh wafts a sickly scent.

lines.zh: 啃食尸体的感觉真是美妙。
lines.en: Savoring the flesh is a delight.

lines.zh: 我会把所有尸体都吃掉。
这些尸体足够我饱餐一顿。
lines.en: These bodies will satisfy my hunger.

lines.zh: 腐烂的肉让我浑身发痒。
这口食物足够我活很久。
lines.en: This meal will keep me going for a while.

lines.zh: 尸体的味道比想象中还要美味。
lines.en: The flesh is even tastier than expected.
My hoof is stuck in a mud pit.

lines.zh: 一块砖头砸在我的身上。
腐肉的味道，能引来同类。
lines.en: The smell of carrion brings my own kind.

lines.zh: 我们需要一个伴侣来繁衍。
lines.en: We need a mate to reproduce.
Come with me—there's food in the trough.

lines.zh: 寻找一个伴侣来延续血脉。
lines.en: Find a partner to continue our line.
Companion at the trough — where are you?

lines.zh: 啃食腐肉时发出咕噜声

lines.en: Drag the corpse into the cave
Makes chewing noises on the corpse
Shows fangs while eating the corpse
Growsls while tearing at the corpse
Carries the corpse back to the nest
Glares at the target with fiery eyes
Living is better—the blood is still warm.

lines.zh: 这一身肉，够我拱上三天。
lines.en: That much meat lasts me three days of rooting.
I will go where it falls.
Tear at the corpse with fangs
Drags the corpse into the cave
Tearing at the corpse with its mouth
Bites and drags the corpse away
Dragging the corpse into the nest
Throat first, so it can't scream.
I wait for it to bleed too much to walk.
My hooves have already dug the soil.
My tusks aim at its belly.

lines.zh: 我数它的呼吸，越来越浅。
lines.en: I count its breaths, shallower each time.
I wait for its eyes to close.
I bite and hold, like a pig at the trough.

lines.zh: 嘶……”，它张开大嘴向你扑来。
lines.en: Sssss… it lunges at you with an open mouth.

lines.zh: 你闻到了它腐烂的气味？
lines.en: Did you smell its decayed stench?
Crunch, it bites into your flesh.

lines.zh: 啊……”它发出令人作呕的声音。
lines.en: Aaah… it makes an awful sound.
Its eyes are hollow and vicious.

lines.zh: 它似乎在考虑下一步行动。
lines.en: It seems to be considering its next move.
The smell of carrion excites it.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶……”，它的眼睛闪烁着绿色光芒。
lines.en: Sssss… its eyes glow with a green light.

lines.zh: 它用獠牙撕裂你的衣服。
lines.en: It rips your clothes with its tusks.
Ah, you will be its meal.

lines.zh: 你叫得越响，我吃得越快。
lines.en: The louder you scream, the faster I eat.

lines.zh: 腐烂的尸体成了它的食物。
它在腐肉堆中寻找猎物。
lines.en: It searches among the carrion for prey.

lines.zh: 腐臭的气息弥漫在空气中。
我这只猪，眼睛有点不对劲。
lines.en: This pig's eyes are not quite right.
It lies in wait in the dark corners.

lines.zh: 腐烂的肉体让它感到满足。

lines.en: It crawls out of the trash pile.

lines.zh: 猪圈里多了一头会吃的猪。
lines.en: The pen has one more pig that eats.
It roots its way out of the corpse pile.
Bloody hoofprints lead all the way here.

lines.zh: 剧情走到第四阶段，它来了。
lines.en: The story reached stage four, and it came.

lines.zh: 它嘴里还叼着一截手指。
lines.en: It still has a finger in its mouth.
A pig's eyes, a man's hunger.

lines.zh: 哼哼，疼，被火烧的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Oink, ouch! — and the fire makes it worse.
My snout hit the ground first. It hurts.

lines.zh: 哎呀，疼，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Ouch, ouch! — and the drown makes it worse.

lines.zh: 嗷，受伤了，遭爆炸的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Oink, hurt! — and the explosion makes it worse.
Purple light crawled up my snout.
This pig face of mine grew teeth.
The lightning made my bristles stand up.

lines.zh: 哎，疼死我了，坠入虚空的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Oink, so painful! — and the void makes it worse.
